ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE

Behind the image
35 / Navy Eyelet
REFERENCE 5794.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 028
Art direction: Sleek wet-look hair, sharp liner, deep navy against a bright white runway, futuristic
tailoring.
Photorealistic vertical runway beauty close-up of an original adult woman with dark brown hair in
a wet-look, side-parted slick-back style with a few loose strands falling across her face, light
blue-gray eyes with a sharp black winged eyeliner, defined brows and glossy peach-nude lips. She
wears a structured deep navy high-neck knit top with raised stitched geometric line panels across
the chest and shoulders and bronze metal eyelets. Bright white fashion-show set, softly blurred
models and legs walking in the background, crisp even runway lighting, shallow depth of field,
sharp focus on the eyes, deep navy against white palette, high-fashion catwalk photography, no
text or logos.
36 / Black Velvet
REFERENCE 5793.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 029
Art direction: Quiet luxury, tonal black on black, rich velvet texture, soft natural runway light.
Photorealistic vertical runway close-up of an original adult woman with straight light brown hair
parted in the center and falling past her shoulders, a few flyaway strands, pale blue eyes, strong
natural brows, light freckles and soft nude-pink lips, with small gold drop earrings. She wears a
tailored black velvet jacket with sculpted puff shoulders and fabric-covered buttons over a fine
black ribbed turtleneck. Softly blurred cream and ivory fashion-show interior behind her with a
dark silhouette, soft diffused runway light, rich velvet texture, tonal black palette, understated
luxury, calm direct gaze, 85mm lens, no text or logos.
